product: CASSIE phoneme and phrase word timing index

aligner.timeline: nested word/token/phone intervals from synthesis-reference MFCC dynamic-time-warping alignment
aligner.ipaKeyRule: The lookup key removes a leading or trailing primary/secondary stress marker from the aligned IPA phone; the original aligned IPA label is retained on each window.
aligner.contextRule: Phone position and neighboring IPA labels are taken from the full ordered phone timeline for each aligned word; neighboring labels omit stress markers.
aligner.wordTimingRule: Multiword clip entries use Echogarden's measured top-level word intervals in seconds relative to the source clip.

licenseNote: The source speech files remain SCP: Secret Laboratory assets under the included CC BY-SA 3.0 evidence. The phoneme-window generation code is part of this AGPL-3.0-only project; Echogarden alignment used eSpeak-NG reference synthesis.
